login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your stashes and deliveries
login.error: Failed to sign in. Check your email and password.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Sign up to start sending stashes
register.error: Failed to register. Check your details and try again.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: We sent a verification code to {email}
verifyEmail.codePlaceholder: Enter the code from the email
verifyEmail.resendSuccess: A new code has been sent.
verifyEmail.successMessage: Email verified. You can now sign in.
verifyEmail.error: Failed to verify email. The code may be invalid or expired.

confirmEmailChange.title: Confirming your new email
confirmEmailChange.successMessage: Email updated. Please sign in again with your new address.
confirmEmailChange.error: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new email change from your profile.
confirmEmailChange.invalidLink: This confirmation link is missing its token.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to set a new password
forgotPassword.sentMessage: If a verified account uses this address, a password reset link is on its way. Only the most recent link works.
forgotPassword.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {n} minute. | Too many requests. Try again in {n} minutes.
forgotPassword.error: Could not send the request. Check your connection and try again.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your Envault account
resetPassword.keysNotice: This changes only your account password. It doesn't affect your stashes and can't recover their encryption keys.
resetPassword.successMessage: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This password reset link is invalid, expired or already used.
resetPassword.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {n} minute. | Too many attempts. Try again in {n} minutes.
resetPassword.error: Could not change the password. Check your connection and try again.
